text: [126] pañcime bhikkhave dhammā anāyussā katame pañca asappāyakārī hoti sappāye mattaṃ na jānāti apariṇatabhojī ca hoti dussīlo ca pāpamitto ca ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā anāyussā 2 . pañcime bhikkhave dhammā āyussā katame #1 po. ...tunti . 2 po. anāyussāti . pañca sappāyakārī hoti sappāye mattaṃ jānāti pariṇatabhojī ca hoti sīlavā ca kalyāṇamitto ca ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā āyussāti .
